text:
Priya (NimbusBank): Quick intake  we need to onboard a transaction reranker + a tiny decision classifier for real-time fraud scoring. Constraints: EU-only data, keys in our HSM, zero retention of raw PII, and strict latency (p50 target ~35ms, p99 <180ms). Renewal in ~28 days so timing is critical. Can CS triage?
Jordan (CS): Thanks Priya  Jordan here. Can you share expected sustained qps and worst-case spike? Also do you have a sanitized eval set we can use for safety/QA?
Priya (NimbusBank): Sustained ~60 qps, spikes up to 220 qps during settlement. We have ~800k labeled transactions (anonymized) and a 10k recent holdout set. We'll upload to SFTP. No PHI but EU residency only.
Rafi (Solutions): Given p99 and spikes, Dedicated with autoscale + burst is recommended. We'll need a sample request trace (payload sizes), and the classifier model size (is it quantized?). Also what's the SLA expectation for retries?
Priya (NimbusBank): Classifier is ~65M and already 8-bit quantized. Reranker is ~7B quant (int8). Retries: business wants max 2 retries with idempotency.
Tina (AM): Flagging renewal risk  if we can't commit a short pilot before renewal, they may talk to competitors. Can we fast-track pre-sales credits?
Kai (Security): Need to confirm KMS/HSM compatibility matrix and whether customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) required. Also request: no raw logs and only aggregated telemetry retained for 30d. We'll require an encrypted transfer + signed transfer token.
onboard-bot: Intake ticket created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/1745129999. Checklist: intake form, security review, eval harness, dedicated sizing, canary runbook.
Rafi (Solutions): Suggested canary policy example: 
```
canary_pct: 5
min_requests: 3000
monitors: [latency_p99, false_pos_rate, error_rate, tail_retries]
rollback_conditions: latency_p99 > 200ms OR error_rate >= 0.8% OR false_pos_rate > 0.6%
```
Rafi (Solutions): We'll need the 10k holdout and a sampled 1k sequence to benchmark real p50/p99 under load. Priya, can you place those into the SFTP path and ping me?
Priya (NimbusBank): Uploading holdout now  DMing SFTP creds. Also note: compliance requires that keys never leave our HSM and that model logs do not include transaction ids.
Jordan (CS): Action list: 1) Priya upload holdout + traffic traces. 2) Rafi to propose Dedicated pool sizing & run a cost estimate. 3) Kai to run HSM/KMS compatibility check and draft KBA. 4) Tina to draft a 60-90 day pilot SOW addendum to cover renewal gap. We'll kick off tomorrow 09:30 CET.
Tina (AM): I'll push a pilot credit offer and internal approval for a fast-track SOM addendum. Marking renewal watch.
Kai (Security): One more ask  explainability: customer needs top-3 signal reasons for each decision for appeal flows. We'll add explainability in gating.
Priya (NimbusBank): Confirmed top-3 required. Also prefer canary traffic limited to EU region only.
Jordan (CS): Great. I'll create ticket #CS-4892 and post minutes after kickoff. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
